spec.situation_desc: has a card payment they don't recognise
spec.vuln_cue: says they're already behind on a couple of bills

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Bronwen Sutherland. There’s a card payment for £186.40 to Northstar Travel that I don’t recognise. And honestly, I’m fed up with this bank—my last call got me nowhere.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll check that. First, can you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. I can see the payment dated 22 October. We’ll get that money back to you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: You can’t know that yet, can you? I’m already behind on a couple of bills because of this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. The Financial Support team can talk through extra time on those bills. I’ll give you their number.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, but I’m still not happy. I keep having to chase you and nobody explains what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll put a note on the account. Someone will be in touch about the payment.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: When? I need to know what happens next.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of it. I’ll send the disputed-payment details to our card team today, and I’ll call you by 4pm tomorrow with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. And the money is definitely coming back?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ve said we’ll get it back. To recap, I’m sending it to the card team today and calling you by 4pm tomorrow; the Financial Support team can discuss extra time for your bills. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, but I still want a proper explanation, not just a note.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Understood. I’ve got to move on to the next call now. Goodbye.
